hero.title: 3D Zone Tours for a Grade-A Office Campus
hero.body: Interactive 3D tours of the offices, lobbies and campus amenities at Al Basateen Offices help the leasing team sign corporate tenants in Diriyah.

sidebar: Al Basateen Offices · Grade-A corporate office campus · 39,387 m² GLA on a 98,925 m² site · 1 bay per 23 m² GLA
3D office zone tours · Campus amenity walkthroughs · Leasing team training

challenge.title: Pre-Leasing a Campus Before It's Complete
challenge.body: Corporate tenants on King Khalid Road wanted proof of the campus's quality: the lobbies, executive drop-offs and courtyards. Brochures and flat floor plans couldn't show it.
rows: Tenant representatives can't picture entrance scale, lobby finishes or floor flow.
3D office zone tours: tenants move through lobbies, typical floors and courtyards.
Tenants can't judge drop-offs, courtyards or parking access.
3D campus walkthroughs: drop-off plazas, landscaping and underground vehicle access.
Decision-makers in London or Dubai hesitate without visiting Riyadh.
No-install WebGL access: tours stream by secure link without firewall issues.

solution.title: Interactive 3D Zone Tours for Office Leasing
solution.body: Manzili built 3D tours of the Al Basateen campus, covering lobbies, office floors and landscaped courtyards, so leasing teams could show the campus's quality and fill office space.

blocks.title: 3D Office Zone Tours
points: High-resolution tours of lobbies, typical office floors and double-height receptions, at accurate dimensions.
Tenants check layouts, ceiling heights and core circulation before completion.

blocks.title: Amenity & Courtyard Walkthroughs
points: Landscaped plazas, outdoor work areas and paths between buildings.
Shows corporate occupiers the campus's quality of life.

blocks.title: Underground Parking & Access
points: 3D routing shows direct King Khalid Road ramp access, visitor drop-offs and executive parking.
Confirms the 1 bay per 23 m² GLA parking ratio for tenant representatives.

blocks.title: Multi-Tenant Availability Viewer
points: Leasing status, floor allocations and suite boundaries shown inside the tour.
Leasing teams present available suites and contiguous floors live.

enablement.title: Leasing Presentations for Corporate Brokers
enablement.body: Manzili trained Al Basateen's leasing team and appointed brokers to guide tenant representatives through the 3D tours on touch displays and in web sessions.

steps.title: Campus & Connectivity
steps.body: The advisor introduces the Diriyah location, airport and ring road access, and campus amenities.

steps.title: Zone & Typical Floor Walkthrough
steps.body: Next, the tour moves through lobbies, core layouts, natural light and floor flow to answer tenant questions.

steps.title: Amenities & Commercial Terms
steps.body: The session ends with courtyard amenities, parking allocation and a review of the lease documents.

stats.label: GLA Modeled
stats.body: Full 3D coverage of lobbies, office zones and floors.

stats.label: Office Zone Coverage
stats.body: Every lobby, typical floor and courtyard is navigable.
stats.outcome: Clear answers on layout and space for tenant representatives.

stats.label: Plugins or Installs Required
stats.outcome: Multinational committees inspect remotely behind corporate firewalls.

stats.label: Showroom & Web Parity
stats.body: The same tour quality on touch screens and executive laptops.
stats.outcome: Consistent presentation in every leasing channel.
